test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: What is the full form of NABARD?

options.text: National Bank for Agriculture and River Development
National Bank for Architecture and Rural Development
National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development
National Body for Agriculture and Rural Development

solution:
The correct answer is __**National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **NABARD** is the acronym used for **National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development.**
 
• NABARD:
 
 
• India's top development bank, NABARD, aims to support fair and sustainable rural and agricultural development.
 
• As per the National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development Act, 1981, it is a statutory body that was founded in 1982 by Parliament.
 
• Its headquarter is located in Mumbai, India.
 
• It **supervises Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) and Cooperative Banks**, assisting them in establishing safe banking procedures and integrating them with the CBS (Core Banking Solution) system.
 
• It offers financing assistance for the construction of rural infrastructure.
 
• It creates credit strategies at the district level to direct and inspire the banking sector to meet these goals.
 
• Current Chairman of NABARD is Shri. Shaji K V
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sivaraman Committee:**

 
 
• In response to pressure from the Indian government, the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI) established the Committee to Review the Arrangements for Institutional Credit for Agriculture and Rural Development (CRAFICARD) in 1979.**
 
• **Former Planning Commission member Shri B. Sivaraman** served as the **committee's chairman.**
 
• The **Committee's report from 1979** stated that a new organizational mechanism was required to give credit-related concerns associated with rural development the focused attention, firm guidance, and undivided attention they require.
 
• As a result, the **National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) was established in 1982 as a statutory organization.**​
